Package com.j3d.gen.properties

Class Property<T,G extends HasProperties>

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.gen.properties.Property<T,G>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the property (allowed types given above)
G - The type of the property provider, this is the class itself which is defining this property.
public class Property<T,G extends HasProperties> extends Object
Defines a singular property of some object which implements HasProperties.

While this is intended to have a converter (used by UI), this is designed in a way to take in generic types. But each type give should follow command parser rules. hence the following values are allowed:

  • Vector3
  • UUID
  • Any extender of GObject
  • Color
  • String
  • Integer
  • Double
  • Boolean

    • propertyProvider

      private final Class<G extends HasProperties> propertyProvider
      The class which defined this property. e.g. GTri may provide it's Vector3 normal, which is provided by itself, but it's id, colour or pivot, are provided by its super class GObject. This is so when multiple objects are selected, only the properties from the same propertyProvider get shown and can be edited in bulk.
